notes: PARSER PATTERN (LooseListParser on Hy-Tek '# bib Name Year School Finals [H#] Points' lists, KVAC files): the parse drops the Place and Points columns (every row place None, no points, so the printed team scores cannot be reproduced), drops relay legs ('1) #182 Name 10 2) ...' lines) and exhibition 'B/C/D' relay rows ('Morse High School 'B' x2:09.50'), drops 'R' record-suffixed marks ('11-06.00R') and reads a trailing tie-break mark or the FOUL after a jump-off 'J' mark as the result ('26-08.00 25-10.50' -> 25-10.50). Status rows (NH/FOUL/DQ/FS/DNF/ND) are dropped by the parser and stay dropped here. Lap-split lines under the distance events and relays (3C) are not stored. FIXES: places and printed points added to every row (Girls/Boys printed team scores 114/94/60/58/31/28/26 and 143/129/49/42/26/20/6 reproduce exactly from the rows' points); relay legs added; 8 exhibition relay teams (x-marked B/C) added with exhibition True and relay_label; Girls Pole Vault Sarah Ouellette 11-06.00 (printed '11-06.00R', KVAC record) added; Girls Triple Jump Virginia Foss mark 26-08.00 (parse had the tie-break mark 25-10.50). 'host' (the timing company's licence line 'Tyler Timing, LLC') dropped. Everything else (events, names, schools, grades, marks) is an unchanged copy of the parse, checked row by row against the source (all rows matched by name and mark). Schools are the 12-character Hy-Tek strings and full relay names; Mt. Ararat H, Maine Centra (MCI), Camden Hills etc. resolve by the catalog. Date and meet name are the sub5 index's (printed Meet Manager date agrees).
